title: Compact recent tray and active snapshot
summary: Browse compact thumbnails below the status row, with a clear active snapshot and protection for ongoing edits.

Improved: Compact recent cards now appear below the status row, with proportionate thumbnails, transparency checkerboards and image/project indicators.
Active-snapshot border, unsaved marker and stored-size tooltip make the current state clearer.
Protected: Reselecting the active thumbnail keeps edits and Undo history. Canceling a replacement preserves both the document and active selection.
Verified: Native selection, Cancel/Discard, Undo and exact320000 annotated/transparent clipboard pixels.
92 regular Rust tests, formatting and strict Clippy. Reference close/Library retention observed with a synthetic canvas.

limitations: Pinning, per-item close, exact source-format badges, absolute timestamps and full reference tray behavior remain planned.
Thumbnails depict stored snapshots; later edits need saving. Per-edit recovery is separate work.
